entities.summary: The Cherkasy National University is a state-sponsored university located in Cherkasy. It is one of the leading universities of Ukraine. More than 95 years old, it has more than 6,000 students that acquire 54 specialties. Currently, its structure consists of 8 institutes and two faculties. The university was named after Ukrainian Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky who was born in Cherkasy region.
